instruction: Use only the supplied task inputs and produce the required outputs; do not use evaluator-generated artifacts. For the steps below, open `/opt/blender/blender` first; Bonsai is available inside it as the installed BIM extension. Open /home/user/Desktop/baseline.ifc in Bonsai. Objective: Balance useful daylight between two learning rooms using several modest windows rather than one oversized opening. This is a continuous-score optimization task, not a request to match one exact answer. Optimization focus: Multi-room daylight balance and overglazing control. Required output: save the final IFC as /home/user/Desktop/optimized.ifc. Optional design_summary.json or preview.png may be created, but the evaluator will ignore optional metrics and will parse the real optimized.ifc geometry. Allowed changes: resize, move, add, or remove IfcWindow objects only on allowed facades; add reasonable IfcShadingDevice objects if useful. Add or update only the matching IfcOpeningElement and IfcRelFillsElement/IfcRelVoidsElement records needed to host those windows. Preserve all rooms/spaces, storeys, slabs, doors, fixed walls, site obstruction walls, room names, building footprint, and IFC4 BIM semantics. Every IfcWindow and preserved IfcDoor must fill exactly one geometric IfcOpeningElement through IfcRelFillsElement, and each opening must void its actual host IfcWall through IfcRelVoidsElement. Do not delete walls, obstructions, slabs, doors, or spaces; do not expand the building; do not place windows through partitions or private/no-window rooms; do not use IfcBuildingElementProxy or visual-only mesh replacements. Room constraints: CLASSROOM A: allowed facades north, south, west, ideal WWR 0.200, hard max WWR 0.300, max windows 5, sill at least 0.85 m, head at most 2.65 m | CLASSROOM B: allowed facades north, south, east, ideal WWR 0.200, hard max WWR 0.300, max windows 5, sill at least 0.85 m, head at most 2.65 m | STORAGE: allowed facades none, ideal WWR 0.000, hard max WWR 0.000, max windows 0, sill at least 1.40 m, head at most 2.50 m. The hidden evaluator computes daylight coverage, normalized mean daylight, uniformity, room balance, glare penalty, WWR fit, object counts, and hard-constraint failures from IFC geometry. Maximize the evaluator's continuous score while satisfying constraints.json and site.json.

metric.name: learning-room daylight balance, WWR, and glare score
